name: Business Implementation Checklist
one_liner: The control that asks whether the organisation actually changed — not whether the system went live.
purpose: The Business Implementation Checklist is the PM² control for Manage Business Implementation. It verifies that the Business Implementation Plan is complete and realistic, that all in-scope business implementation activities are in the Project Work Plan, that process redesign, communication, organisational change and training were executed, and that status and post-project recommendations were reported. Its template was not available in this extraction, so the structure below is reconstructed from guide section 9.12 and the Business Implementation Plan's own sections.
created_in: Planning Phase — tailored from the Business Implementation Plan (setup output, guide p.53); run during Executing / Monitor & Control
approved_by: Not formally approved — a control tool (guide p.69); the BM manages the activities it checks and the PO is Accountable

lifecycle.what: Tailored from the Business Implementation Plan as a setup output
Run as change, communication and training activities are delivered
BM manages the activities; PM assists and updates the Work Plan
Open items become Post-Project Recommendations in the Project-End Report

fields.what: Customise the checklist when planning business implementation, basing it on the Business Implementation Plan; it also helps identify the key controls for those activities.
fields.castor: Tailored 26 Jun 2026 with the BIP; run quarterly from Q3 2027 through cutover.

fields.what: One of four values per check — Yes, Yes Partially, No, N/A — scored to give a compliance figure, following the PM² checklist house pattern.
fields.castor: Training check answered 'Yes, Partially' in Feb 2028: 26 of 40 administrators trained.

fields.what: Justification for the answer given — the evidence behind each business implementation check.
fields.castor: 'Remaining 14 administrators scheduled across March and April 2028 cohorts.'

fields.what: Auto-calculated readiness score for business implementation, reported alongside transition readiness but measuring a different thing.
fields.castor: Reported to Florence Nightingale monthly; distinct from the Transition Checklist score.

fields.what: Checked in Planning and re-checked before execution: BIP complete and realistic, impact on processes, people and culture analysed, communications strategy defined, training needs determined, resistance identified.
fields.who: BM verifies · BIG consulted · PO accountable
fields.castor: Confirmed at the RfE gate, 03 Jul 2026, with impact on 40 loan administrators quantified.

fields.f: Is the Business Implementation Plan complete and realistic?
fields.what: Guide step 1 verbatim — the first duty in Manage Business Implementation and the only check that questions the plan itself rather than its execution.
fields.castor: Re-answered after the SRF-backstop change request added a post-project onboarding activity.

fields.f: Activities in the Project Work Plan (step 2)
fields.what: Checked while planning and re-planning: all in-scope business implementation activities are defined, scheduled and resourced in the Project Work Plan, with the project versus permanent-organisation split agreed.
fields.castor: Training, process republication and promotion activities carried into the Work Plan baselined 26 Jun 2026.

fields.what: Checked continuously: attention stays on activities implemented during the project's duration and clearly under its budget and control; the rest is handed on.
fields.castor: Annual refresher training and control self-assessment explicitly excluded and passed to Lending Operations.

fields.what: Checked as change lands: affected business processes redesigned, adapted or updated, planned organisational change management activities implemented, new processes published and in use.
fields.castor: Disbursement procedure republished with system-enforced segregation of duties before 15 May 2028.

fields.what: Checked as delivery proceeds: BIP communication activities implemented, promotion carried out, all training activities completed, business continuity plans for business-critical systems managed.
fields.castor: Three-day course plus shadowing completed for all 40 loan administrators by 30 Apr 2028.

fields.what: The check that owns training. The Transition Checklist merely asks whether training was given; here it is planned, resourced, delivered and verified by the Business Manager.
fields.who: BM owns · BIG delivers · PM assists
fields.castor: Grace Hopper closed this check 30 Apr 2028, unblocking the Transition Plan's cutover prerequisite.

fields.what: Checked at reporting points and at closure: status and changes to business implementation activities reported, benefits-tracking metrics and owners defined, post-project recommendations captured.
fields.who: BM reports · PM updates Work Plan · PO endorses
fields.castor: SC1–SC5 tracking handed to Lending Operations for quarterly measurement from Q1 2029.

traps: PM² provides this checklist, but the BM — not the PM — owns the activities it verifies.
It checks organisational change; the Transition Checklist checks the system cutover.
Checks legitimately stay open at closure — business implementation outlives the project.
PO is Accountable and PSC only Informed, mirroring the Business Implementation Plan's RASCI.
Listed among the six PM² checklists on guide p.69, so it is a real PM² artefact, not optional local practice.
